title: A Novel Approach to Assess and Measure Resorption of Allograft Cancellous Blocks. A Clinical Pilot
authors: Study Patel, J., Srinivas , A., Patel, N., Bhakta, S., & Keeling, A. (2024). Journal of Osseointegration, 16(1), 48–52.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft bonebuilder (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “This novel method may be beneficial to investigate the treatment outcomes from alveolar block grafting with greater accuracy than previous methods, whilst also providing new information on the patterns of resorption within blocks” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
